main.title: Welcome to MSBT
main.body:
You need Borderlands 4 + the MSBT SDK mod (.sdkmod in the game’s sdk_mods folder) + this Electron app. Live actions also need a connected bridge — use header Refresh Status.

Offline: serial convert/validate. Live (game + mod + bridge): boosting, spawns, travel, delivery.

Put MattsSDKBoostingTools.sdkmod next to ActorScriptDeployer under Borderlands 4/sdk_mods/. Or use Updates → Install / Update SDK Mod.

Tip: Updates → Refresh Data Catalogs pulls the latest serial/travel/pool JSON without a full app reinstall.

main.title: Updates
main.body:
Check Electron app and SDK mod versions here. Download Electron updates, or Install / Update SDK Mod into your Borderlands 4 sdk_mods folder. Fully restart the game after any SDK change.

Refresh Data Catalogs updates high-churn JSON (codes, travel, pools, Dev Spawner) from the MSBT data channel — separate from app SemVer.
